_note: Authored, not generated. The sequences a script's fonts and shaping engines actually disagree on — the tier-3 evidence every verdict is computed from. Carried across from the design prototype. The desktop companion reads this same list, so both products share one definition of what clean, caveat and fail mean.

Deva.note: ksha, the conjunct every Devanagari font is judged by
repha: ra + virama reorders above the following consonant
rakar: ra below the base, the mirror case of repha
a half form joining two consonants
nukta below the base; a font may draw it clear of the descender or on top of it
the Marathi eyelash ra, which Hindi-only fonts routinely get wrong
the i-matra is stored after its consonant and drawn before it — the reordering every Indic shaper has to do
